name: Brazil (Empire, 19 stars, 1822–1853)
description: A green field with a large yellow lozenge bearing the imperial coat of arms: a crowned green shield with the armillary sphere and a ring of nineteen stars, within branches of coffee and tobacco.
history: First flag of the Empire of Brazil, adopted on 1 December 1822 at the coronation of Pedro I; the green and yellow stand for the houses of Braganza and Habsburg and the ring of nineteen stars for the provinces. Imperial Law No. 15 of 29 August 1853 added a twentieth star for the new province of Paraná.
